title: Product performance
markdown:
### EDR Performance

The EDR product blocked credential_theft attacks 11,663 times in 2026, an increase of 80.4% from 6,464 in the previous year. Ransomware attacks fell by 9.2%, dropping from 2,137 to 1,940. This finding states that ransomware is the only attack type to decline.

### Firewall Performance

The Firewall product blocked Malware download attacks at 223,501 times, an increase of 24.1% from 180,156. This was the largest year-over-year change among all attack types. Brute force attacks decreased by 29.3%, falling from 3,591,554 to 2,539,855. This product reports only blocked events, so a block rate cannot be calculated.
